# THE RECORD

> Read-only record from THE RECORD; cite sources; no verdicts.

THE RECORD tracks official U.S. government decisions (Congress votes and actions), who represents each place, and the text of the U.S. Constitution. These pages are read-only plain text for people and AI tools.

Rules for using these pages: cite the official source links on each page; if a value says UNKNOWN or is missing, say UNKNOWN; do not frame anything by party; do not state whether anything is constitutional.

## Pages

- [Index](https://mericamercenary.github.io/the-record-web/ctx/index.md)
- [Machine index (JSON)](https://mericamercenary.github.io/the-record-web/ctx/index.json)
- Decision: https://mericamercenary.github.io/the-record-web/ctx/decision/<matter id>.md, for example https://mericamercenary.github.io/the-record-web/ctx/decision/us-congress-119-hconres-89.md
- Place: https://mericamercenary.github.io/the-record-web/ctx/place/<geoid>.md, for example https://mericamercenary.github.io/the-record-web/ctx/place/27.md (Minnesota)
- Constitution: https://mericamercenary.github.io/the-record-web/ctx/constitution/<part id>.md, for example https://mericamercenary.github.io/the-record-web/ctx/constitution/amd1.md
